summary: Daniel Palmer, of Fort Collins, got turned around on the descent of Capitol Peak and became stranded on the north face below the summit, unable to descend or climb back up; he called authorities from a cell phone; Mountain Rescue Aspen plus a Blackhawk helicopter extracted him; he suffered only minor injuries.
location: Capitol Peak, north face below summit
notes: Via Aspen Times reporting cited by coloradomountaineering.com (page opened 2026-09-14); distinct from the 2013-07-19 Ryan Palmer fatality (id 186 — no relation per source).
